CLM-MAT-0172.statement: The cohesive energy per atom of the monolayer black phosphorene baseline is calculated to be -5.09 eV.

extra_quotes: Using the Chiraltube software, a comprehensive set of 214 PNTs was generated and analyzed via a 2D zone-folding mapping approach. Subsequently, a representative subset of 48 chiral PNTs was selected forab initiocalculations covering the full chiral space.

While the mapping method overestimates band gaps by directly inheriting monolayer features, it serves as a qualitative tool for specific chiral geometries—particularly armchair configurations and larger-radius tubes—by effectively capturing their subband density and dispersion profiles.
